apps.name: RagaMentor
apps.versionDescription: v1.5.41 — The loop note editor's Cancel and Done move out of the system keyboard accessory bar — its square container clashed with the keyboard's rounded edges — into a floating bar in the app's own colours that rides just above the keyboard while you edit. Done saves, Cancel restores the saved note, and dragging the page now puts the keyboard away too (which also saves).
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.

versions.localizedDescription: Phrases migrate to the shared SequencePlayer (P-C).
